fixed-polyhedron-ellipsoid-local-hotspot.limitations: Numerical marking uses all five audited seed raw maxima and every original physical load anchor, with a declared fixed physical-space marking radius. No original load/material/footprint, seed boundary geometry or original convergence probe is changed. Every child tetrahedron is contained in a parent and every parent volume is checked, alongside total volume/area/COM. Volume and surface-basis refinement and boundary quadrature still couple. Marking uses measured seed hotspots and cannot establish a universal error estimator or exclude another global peak. All original field budgets, probes and unaveraged global maxima must be retained in subsequent solves and independent audits. Asset generation solves zero new equilibria.

fixed-polyhedron-ellipsoid-local-origina.scope: Qualify unchanged original finite-load fields, then refine their declared geometry family using independent FEM.
fixed-polyhedron-ellipsoid-local-origina.limitations: Fresh stiffness/mass/RHS, all original complete-force budgets, original continuous traction vectors, every corner/quadrature tensor and every original physical probe are rechecked without a new solve. This qualifies the isolated pure-FEM reference path on the existing mesh, not a physical tail or native model/cost accuracy.

limitations: Six full locally refined meshes preserve original geometry, seed vertices, each parent volume, total volume/area/COM and all original loads. Ten original million-cell fields freshly requalify before any local solve using unchanged full force/corner/quadrature/probe gates. Only original probe filename selection is added; no numerical algorithm, tolerance or physical input changes. Local marking uses all original maxima and load anchors. Volume/surface basis and boundary quadrature still couple. Mesh setup and original requalification solve zero new equilibria; live fine solves/auditors are excluded. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
